requirements.text: Users shall be able to complete high-frequency tasks with a maximum of five clicks from their respective dashboard.
requirements.evidence_quote: Users shall be able to complete high-frequency tasks (e.g., a Teacher marking attendance, a Student checking grades) with a maximum of five clicks from their respective dashboard.

requirements.text: Every critical action must result in immediate, visual confirmation or an error message.
requirements.evidence_quote: Every critical action (e.g., successful submission of grades, password change) must result in immediate, visual confirmation or an error message, reducing user uncertainty.
